**Review, 2026-11-17.** An independent review of U17 (its notes, probes and breaks in `target/review-u17/`) held the `Arc` never copied per frame, Find's slice, Only lines with text, the list's keys the active editor's, References stopped on another line, the rest test catching a repaint loop, String read-only for the game's table, the Text field's id, the header's control list and the game's lines numbered by their own StrRefs; it found these, all fixed in this change, each with a test seen to fail with its fix taken out (`target/u17/breaks.txt`, "Fix round": F1 to F15). **Faults shown.** (1) **Two typing sessions on one line were one step of Undo**: `mg_module::talk::Table::set_line` joined typing into the same field of the same line until a Save. A burst now ends where it is ended: `Table::end_typing` (new), called as another line is chosen (`talk_view::follow`, by the line seen the frame before) and as a String field is left (`panels::string`, after what was typed is set), and by `Table::undo` and `redo` themselves (typing after an Undo never joins the step now last). `talk_panels::two_typing_sessions_on_one_line_are_two_steps` (the review's probe: "a" into line 3, line 4 clicked, line 3 clicked, "b": one Undo takes "b" alone; and the field left between two bursts) [F1], mg-module's `a_burst_of_typing_ends_where_it_is_ended` (the Undo case) [F2]. (2) **Find in `dialog.tlk` matched a custom table's StrRefs**: `Table::has` tried `Table::strref(row)` (16777216 and up) for every table; a table has its own first number now (`first_strref`: `CUSTOM`, 0 for `Table::of_game`), and Find takes it (`dialog_tlk_opens_read_only_and_numbered_by_its_strrefs`: "16777223" finds nothing there, "7" finds line 7) [F3]. (3) **Length's per-line id was needed and unguarded**: the first test typed nothing after the move, so one id for every line passed it (my B18). The test now types "9" into line 3's Length, chooses line 5, types "1" and Enter (line 5's Length as it was), and the same for Sound (`text_typed_keeps_to_its_own_line`) [F4, F5]. (4) **A floating editor's first size**: the window opened at most 0.85 of the room between the docks, so in the pictures' 1280 by 720 shell a talk table's window was about 815 wide, its header Find, Go to, More, OK and Cancel alone and String about 170 high with Length out of sight. **The coordinator's ruling**: an editor that brings window panes (a talk table, a 2DA, a conversation) opens clipped to the main window less a margin (`Moonglow::open_window`, 24 a side), not to the room between the docks: it may stand over a dock, as a window dragged there does. In its window String has a larger share (`shell::TALK_WINDOW_SHARES`, 1100, 300 and 600), so that Text, Sound and Length show whole at the window's first size: without it the pictures' `talk-floating-720` cut Sound and hid Length; the app test, in the tests' unthemed harness whose String section stands taller, does not see it (F7 not seen: said, and held by the pictures). `a_floating_editor_of_panes_opens_at_its_first_size` (1280 by 720 and 1600 by 900: each kind as wide as it asks where the screen has it; the talk header holding every control, Find, Go to, Add Line, Find References and Export with their words, Remove Last Line, Save and Only lines with text as icons, the imports and the files in More; String's Text, Sound and Length whole; a 2DA's Cell's Value whole) [F6]. U16's floating tests follow the ruling: `a_floating_table_s_columns_fold_to_a_strip` at a screen of 1300 (at 1600 the window has the room for its Outliner now), `a_floating_table_s_header_beside_its_panes`' new window keeps Add Row's words, `the_grid_s_keys_are_the_active_editor_s` in a screen of 2400 (Module Properties in sight beside the window). (5) **Claims wider than their tests**: `text_typed_keeps_to_its_own_line` now imports over the line typed in (the field shows the import's, what is typed after it lands nowhere) [F8]; the rest test's Find runs over 150,040 lines of a `dialog.tlk` of ours (still looking after two frames, then at rest) [F9]. **Suspected, probed.** (a) **A long Find's late frames**: each frame cloned the lines found so far and made a new list; the lines listed are now appended to a list shared with the list drawn (`talk_view::sweep`, `Arc::make_mut`: no copy while nothing else holds it), Only lines with text filtering each slice's new lines alone, the clock asked every 64 lines (`SWEEP_SLICE`, was 512). `frame_perf`'s Find "e" with Only lines with text on `dialog.tlk` (new, every frame of it timed): its worst frame 3.9 ms, its last fifth's 3.4 to 3.7, against the tip's 17.5 ms in the one frame it is typed. (b) Quick Open's "dialog.tlk" hit is pushed within `MOST` (counted either way). (c) **A hak's own `dialog.tlk`**: the game reads its talk table from the install's `lang` folder alone, so a hak's resource of that name is a resource as any: the Resources panel lists it beside the game's row (the game's row is now added whatever the load order holds) and it opens as a hak's resources do; Quick Open's hit is `Target::GameTalk` (new), the game's table (since the owner's ruling shown in the Talk Table tab), whatever a hak holds (`a_hak_s_dialog_tlk_is_a_resource_of_its_own`) [F10]. (d) **With `dialog.tlk` in front**: the Top Bar's Undo is the module's (the table has no steps of its own; its tab notes no pointer for Undo, as a read-only 2DA's), and a paste over its list changes nothing; a tab kept from a session with no game data says why it is empty and fills as the game data comes (`dialog_tlk_in_front_changes_nothing`) [F11]; with the game's folder or language changed the game data read is another, and the tab's lines are made again from it (`game_table`'s key). A file dropped on the window opens as it does beside any tab (not probed by a test: kittest gives no dropped files). (e) **Export**: the module's CSV and JSON are written by the same `transfer` and `Table::to_csv` and `to_json` as before U17; `a_talk_table_s_export_is_as_before` holds the bytes to them and to an authored CSV [F12]. **Board differences, the board deciding.** String's Sound and Length, read-only, are text that can be chosen and copied (`panels::looked_field`), not disabled controls; a References row carries the line's text quoted before its field ("m1q1faribeth › NPC line 41 “Welcome, <FullName>. I regret I did not” › Text", `panels::quoted`) [F15]; File breaks at its separators, never inside a folder's name (`panels::at_separators`); the list is painted by `table_view::look` (`cell` for each row's fill, `Lines` for the lines under the rows and the ring of the chosen row while the list has the keys, as the 2DA grid's cursor; no outline round the whole list), not a copy of it. **Kept, listed**: the list and the 2DA grid both scroll by points (`show_rows`), so a row may be cut under the header row in both; `Lines` draws one line at the rows' right edge (one cell a row), beside the scroll bar; no Play beside Sound (the old editor had none: nothing lost; `Talk_right.png` alone draws it); "Name it: …" under Create (the old page said it, and the form needs it while Create is off). **Rulings.** The owner's, 2026-11-17: `dialog.tlk` draws in the Talk Table tab, as `Talk.png` draws it (it had been kept in a tab of its own titled "dialog.tlk" by the coordinator's ruling, as plan against board, and put to the owner; "One tab" below). The coordinator's: References from `dialog.tlk` look through the module and its haks, not the game's own 2DAs: kept, and said in the panel ("The game's own 2DAs are not searched.") and in manual 03. The memory claim says it as it is: one copy made as it is shown, shared after, let go of as the tab shows another table or closes (the moves row, manual 03; worded so since the owner's ruling). The never-taller sweeps of U15 (`data_is_never_taller_where_wider_and_comes_to_rest`) and U16 (`never_taller`) are held to the least height at any narrower width [F13, F14: a growth of a quarter point a step, which their step-to-step checks let through]; Data and Cell pass it. **Pictures** (Dark and Light, all seventeen of each looked at, `target/ui-mock/impl/m4-u17-fix/`): `board_talk`, `talk-own`, `talk-1280`, `talk-floating`, `talk-floating-720`, `talk-no-table`, and the new `floating_first_sizes` case's `table-floating-720` and `conversation-floating-720` (the first-size ruling). **Timing** (`target/ui-mock/perf-m4/u17-fix/`, `summary.txt`): after the last code edit, release, alone, a fresh tip copy (`c5f3e341`, its case patched alike) and U17 interleaved over eight runs, each begun at a 1-minute load of 1.9 to 2.4. Medians: docked pointer 0.295 against 0.36 ms, idle 0.29 against 0.36, wheel 0.34 against 0.45; Find "e" with Only lines with text, worst frame 17.5 against 3.9; U17's own worst cases, Only lines with text switched each frame 2.3 ms and Find begun again each frame 4.1 to 4.4 ms. The budget, 6.94 ms, is far off; the tip's copy is deleted.

**One tab, 2026-11-17 (the owner's ruling: "It should draw inside 'Talk Table'").** `dialog.tlk` draws inside the Talk Table tab, as `Talk.png` draws it; `Tab::GameTalkTable` and its kind "game-talk-table" are gone. **Built.** The tab shows the game's table while `Moonglow::game_talk` holds it (`talk_view::Which::shown`; `Which::of(app, tab)` reads the tab through it, so the keys, the panels, the Status Bar, `Moonglow::step_pane` and the window's first size follow what the tab shows); the Resources panel's row and Quick Open's hit push `Action::ShowGameTalk` (new), whose `talk_view::show_game` makes the copy (`game_table`, once), ends the module's burst of typing and opens the tab or brings it forward (a second open does nothing more; without a module the tab opens showing it); `talk_view::ui` draws `game_ui` while it is shown. More › Module's Table (`run_asked`; with a file's table opened by Open File… behind, it goes on to the module's, as the file's own Module's Table does, where the file's has no unsaved changes), the Talk Table panel's Module's Table and Open File… and New File… (`file`) let go of the copy (`hide_game`); `talk_view::follow` lets go of it as the tab closes, but not while the tab's opening is still asked for. **The module's table while `dialog.tlk` is shown** waits untouched behind it: its unsaved lines, Undo steps, chosen line, scroll and Find, and what was typed (the burst ended as the tab left it), all there on its return; nothing typed while `dialog.tlk` is shown reaches it (String read-only, the list's keys the shown table's), nor the Top Bar's Undo and Redo nor Ctrl+Z (Undo last worked in the module's table is not taken from it while it is out of sight: `Moonglow::worked_side_editor`), and its Find under way is let go of (`follow`: a table's look goes where its tab shows the other table; begun again as its list is drawn), so the window comes to rest. The old editor's Open File… does otherwise: it refuses while the module's table has unsaved changes ("save it (or undo them) first") and puts the file's table in the module's place; `dialog.tlk`, only looked at, need neither, so it is shown over the module's table instead (Open File… itself is as before). **Close and Cancel**: Close while `dialog.tlk` is shown (it is only looked at); Cancel after the module's table, `dialog.tlk` and the module's table again covers one span, as if the tab had never left (`may_cancel` asks Save or Don't Save); the tab closed while `dialog.tlk` is shown, unsaved lines behind it, closes as its × does on the module's table, the lines kept for the module's Save. **Restart**: the tab does not remember that it showed `dialog.tlk`, as it does not remember a file shown by Open File…; a record of the old tab (`game-talk-table`, written from `27ce7852` to `92ede11d`) reads without a fault and opens the Talk Table tab showing `dialog.tlk` (`open_tabs::Want::GameTalk`; its line under the old kind is not restored); a record with both old tabs, in one pane or two, opens one Talk Table tab, in front, showing `dialog.tlk`. Settings kept by a kind's name (window sizes and places) are lists of names: an old "game-talk-table" entry is read and left unused. **Tests** (`target/u17/breaks.txt`, "One tab": O1 to O17, each seen to fail with its piece taken out; O1, O7 and O12 seen after their tests were made to reach them, as said there): `dialog_tlk_shows_in_the_talk_table_tab_and_the_module_s_table_waits` (shown as Quick Open shows it with String's Text still focused, a second time the same copy and one tab; **U18. The NUI designer: header and docks (2 days).**

- **Builds.** The design group's header: Design, Bindings, Events & Variants, Images as a switch; Build & compile as the primary icon button; Export…; More (Import…, How to open it…); Interact, Reset; the **View** popover (Editor, Preview only, Split source, UI scale, State, Resources, Clean view, Screen); OK and Cancel. Title case (ruling 8).
- **Settles.** "In the NUI designer's narrow layout … opening a combo box inside the Properties menu closes the menu".

- **Pictures.** `board_nui`.
- **Timing.** `nui_perf`.
- **Docs.** 18-nui-creator.

**Done, 2026-11-17.** **Built.** **The header** (`nui_view::header`, the kit's `EditorHeader` named `NUI_HEADER`, "NUI window header", the board's; its names exported as `mg_ui::nui_names`): the pages' switch (`PAGE`, a `custom` segmented radio group, primary, into More whole: Design, Bindings, Events & Variants, Images; Images out of Advanced), a line, **Build & Compile** (`Item::button(Icon::Compile)` with `look(Primary)`, `icon_only`, off while the checks count errors, its tip counting them), **Export…** (icon), More after it (`more_after`) with **Import…** and **How to Open It…** (now a `widgets::dialog` of its code, Copy and Close; Escape closes it alone); at the right **Interact** (the play toggle) and **Reset** (restart icon, off outside Interact; `State::interact`, `State::reset`), and **View**, a kit `Popover` (`view_combo` rows: Layout, UI scale, State (off in Interact), and Screen as dropdowns that open in it; Resources, Clean view and Preview on screen as checks; a Screen size chosen turns Preview on screen on, as the old menu did); OK and Cancel in the end slot (ruling 10; `blueprint::OK_CANCEL_TIPS`). The page chosen takes effect from the next frame (`run_header`). Until U19 a row under the header keeps Event Script…, Advanced (JUI Source, Binding JSON, Opener Script), Not built / Build failed and the checks' count with its list (`source_row`); the canvas's row keeps "Game preview" and Zoom Fit / 100% (`preview::stage::toolbar`), Interact, Reset, UI scale, State, Resources, Clean view and Screen gone from it. The NUI tab no longer reads "Toolbar buttons" (R4). **The docks** (`crates/mg-ui/src/nui_view/panels.rs`; `shell.rs`): `Panel::Components` ("Components") and `Panel::Bindings` ("Bindings") with every arm (`dock`, `name`, `named`, `icon`, `strip_tip`, `keys`: `Keys::NuiComponents` and `Keys::NuiBindings`, F6 giving Find a control and the Bindings panel's first field the focus; on the one bar's own top row under 1400); Bindings' detail "N binds". `brings_of(Tab::Nui)` brings `NUI_RIGHT` (Components over Properties over Bindings), `NUI_FOLDED` (one bar under 1400), the board's shares (`NUI_SHARES`: Components 166 and Bindings 222 of 811), its window's own (`NUI_WINDOW_SHARES`, Properties' Content whole at the first size), `outliner`, `floats`, on every page and in every Layout (first on the Design page in the Editor view alone, `panels::brings`, gone in the review round); its fields' ids the designer's and the control's (`fields::of`). **Bindings** (`panels::bindings`, `design::bindings_in`): the Bindings page's body (Create Bind, each bind, Client Delivery, Window Identity); the table is U19's. **Layers** (`outliner::Owner::Nui`, `Contents::Layers`, `panels::layers`): the Outliner's header (its name, the window's, Expand All, Collapse All, Layer Actions), Find a layer or ID…, the window as rows (`panels::rows`, made again only as the window's bytes, its folds, its Find or the variant edited change) with kind icons, arrows, draw-layer rows and a swap layout's Initial Contents and variants; only the rows in sight laid out; a click chooses (Ctrl+click several), a drag moves or reparents, a component dropped on a row is added there; the canvas's choice opens its row out and brings it into sight; its keys (`Keys::Marks`, F6): Options › Keyboard's NUI keys as the canvas takes them (Previous, Next, Fold, Unfold, Delete, Duplicate, Move Up, Move Down, Copy, Cut, Paste), Home, End, Page Up and Down, Enter, letters by a control's words, Escape handing them back; none while a dialog, a menu or a kit popover is open. Its seam is its own (`Settings::layers_panel_height`, `OVER_LAYERS_HIGH` 416, the board's). A floating designer brings them into its window (the right pane; Layers its left pane where the canvas keeps `WINDOW_CANVAS_AT_FIRST`, else the fold strip, `outliner::strip` and `over`). **One copy, one step** (`nui_view::Work`, `begin`, `end`, `follow`): the window and its settings are parsed once for the bytes they are and copied once into a working copy kept while the module holds the same bytes; every part (Layers, the three panels, the pages, the canvas) edits it in place; `begin` (whichever part draws first in the pass) empties the fields' stores, applies a link's choice, swaps a variant into the window's place and lets go of a selection whose control is gone; `end` (the editor's, after its window's Layers over the canvas, before `window_drawn_but`) does what Layers, Properties' swap layout buttons, the variants' bar and Components chose (`Picked`, `Chosen`), drops, unswaps, takes the shown values out (`fields::put_back`, which now records where: `fields::Reverted`), sets a field's typed text whose panel went (`fields::recover`), writes the text and inserts one `Apply` where the editor began asking; `nui_view::follow` ends the frames of designers whose editor was not drawn. The fields' stores are each designer's (`fields::enter`). The canvas's keys are the active designer's only (`table_view::active_tab`, as U16's grid and U17's list), and skip while a popover, a dialog or a menu is open or a list or panel has the keys; a press on the canvas gives them back to it. **Title case** (ruling 8): headings and buttons (Size & Layout, Advanced Properties, Property Binding, Bind Formatting, Draw Layers, List Cell, Row Data, When This Value Changes, Window Identity, Client Delivery, Add Property, Use Existing Bind, Draw Primitive (the typed "+ " a drawn plus since the review round), Element Actions' rows, the palette's buttons, JUI Source); a control's words in Layers and the checks keep the board's sentence case ("Text input · Enter text"). **The kit** (`mg_uikit::controls::segmented_in`, a behavior change, said): the radio group is named on its scope's response of this frame, not on `ui.response()` (the last frame's), which said a group in a floating window moved since was 14 points off.

**Review, 2026-11-17.** An independent review of U18 found typed text landing on the wrong control, four tests wider than their bodies (A2 to A5), an untested kit change, Components unusable in a small floating designer and title case missed on the Images page; the coordinator ruled on the docks, Properties' form and the header. Each is fixed below, each new or strengthened test seen to fail with its fix taken out (`target/u18/breaks.txt` under "Fix round", `breaks_fix.py`). **The coordinator's rulings**: the docks stay on every page and in every Layout, with no jump in the editor's width; Components adds to the control chosen; Properties as the board draws them (label beside field in form rows, over it only where the row has no room, never taller where wider; bold section headings that may fold; Width and Height on one row; Source with the board's plus icon button; descriptions as tooltips; Add Property with a drawn plus); a drawn plus (the kit's icon) on every adding button instead of a typed "+ "; the header's order by `Nui.png` and `src/Nui.html`; the View popover's rows as form rows; Layers' Window row with the window's title as its detail; the row kept under the header accepted. **Fixed.** (A1) Typed text on the wrong control: the bytes re-read under a field typed in (an edit from elsewhere) used to set what was typed on the control that took its path (the tip did the same: its probe on 27ce7852 wrote "Hear ye?" over "Oyez"); now `begin` lets the typing go (`State::typing` in the fields' id, the `reverted` list emptied): what was typed lands nowhere, typed after it goes to the control chosen then (`a_field_s_typing_ends_as_the_window_changes_under_it`, the reviewer's probe with two labels [F1]). (A3) The narrow test measured the tab's title (`tab_rect`, 102 by 28): it measures the header's row (`editor_rect`, the kit's header record). (A4) The records test now uses the tip's own records (written by the tip itself in its copy: the open-tabs record of the designer in a window of its own, whose rect, 1125.4 by 774.9 there, is set by hand to 1140 by 792, the size a builder's `window_sizes` keeps, also set by hand since the tip wrote none for an unsized window; no view fields, which the tip never wrote) and checks the designer opening at that size: its own window, Layers a pane or the strip, the header's controls held, Properties' fields whole in its window [F3]. **U19. The NUI designer: source group, Checks, overlays (2 days).**

- **Builds.** The source as a second editor group with its switch (JUI Source, Binding JSON), Opener Script and Event Script… in its header; the **Checks** panel in the Bottom Dock with its switch and count; "Not built" and "Build failed" in the Status Bar in `warn`; Fit, 100% and "Game preview" in the canvas's corners; the hints (Click Select, Drag Resize by handle, Esc Cancel resize, Ctrl + D Duplicate, Alt + Up Move up, Delete) and "3 binds, 3 handlers"; the Outliner's warning mark and weak IDs; the bind chip; Bindings as a table.
- **Ticks.** Every NUI Designer row and its New bullets.
- **Tests.** The Checks switch's count follows the checks; the source group opens beside the design and keeps its switch; "Not built" in the Status Bar until a build.
- **Pictures.** `board_nui`. **Timing.** `nui_perf`. **Docs.** 18.

**Done, 2026-11-18.** **What it is** (by Part 2's decision 2 and the board's tab strip, `crier.jui` beside `crier_e.nss`, which a pane of the designer's tab could not hold; `shell::owner_of` was reserved for it in U2): **the source group is a tab of its own**, `Tab::NuiSource(key)` (kind "nui-source", named as the window, its icon the designer's), a part of the designer of its window: `owner_of` maps it to `Tab::Nui(key)` (now a `Cow`), so while it is the editor in front the docks, the Outliner (Layers), Checks and the Status Bar's counts are its designer's (`panels::nui_of` takes both); `shell::window_panes` draws none for it. **Opens and closes**: View › Layout › Split source (`Action::NuiSource(key, true)`, `Moonglow::open_nui_source`) splits the designer's leaf at its right, the design keeping the board's share (`nui_view::SOURCE_SHARE`, 640 of 1018), or brings it forward; in a floating designer's window it splits there and the window widens by `SOURCE_WIDTH` (420, moved left where the screen's edge is in the way; on a screen too narrow the design gives up its own down to the board's share), its width given back as the group closes (`Moonglow::nui_widened`, also when closed by its ×: `nui_view::follow`); Layout's Editor or Preview only, or its ×, closes it, and the Layout reads Split source exactly while it is open (from `Moonglow::panes_tabs`: **the dock is a placeholder while tabs draw**, the agdb note); the repair's Open JUI Source and Open Binding JSON (a window or settings that do not read) open it on that position. **Remembers**: its switch per designer for the session (`State::source_of`), and in the module's open-tabs record (`nui-source:NAME.jui`, its view's `page` "JUI Source" or "Binding JSON", `open_tabs::View::page`), its width by the record's split as any group's; a record of it without its designer opens without it (`follow` closes a source whose designer is gone); an older Moonglow reads the record and drops the kind it does not know. **Two designers** each have their own (a second one in the first's window tested; two docked, read from the code); **the design's tab closed** takes it with it (tested); **moved to another group** it stays where it is (read from the code: nothing follows the design's place); **in the narrow layout** it is a group as any, the design narrower beside it; **renamed** with the window (`references.rs`, tested). A bound property's chip asks Property Binding of its own designer (`form::chip_owner`, keyed by designer: two designers drawn in one frame never take each other's; read from the code, not tested). An older Moonglow reading a record with `nui-source:` drops the kind it does not know (read from `open_tabs::parse_tab`, not run). **Its header** (`source::header`, the kit's `EditorHeader` named "Source header"): the switch "Source" (JUI Source, "The window's layout as JSON"; Binding JSON, "The window's settings as JSON: binds, handlers, variants"), at its right **Event Script…** with the script icon ("Open the event script, NAME_e.nss": the event script written and opened at its handlers, as before; off while the settings do not read) and **Opener Script** (the file icon, `NAME_o.nss` opened; off until Build & Compile makes it, its tip saying so). As Tabs the script opens in the focused group, the source group whose header was clicked: the board's `crier_e.nss` beside `crier.jui`. **Its text**: the module's own bytes (the JUI Source page's, not Split source's re-serialized copy: what does not read is shown and kept as it is), numbered and colored a line at a time by the script editor's `script_layout::LaidOut` in its font and colors, kept between frames for the text it is (a line laid out again only where it changed; `numbers` kept for the count of lines); one draft (`SourceDraft`) per designer; **what is typed is set when the field is left**, one Undo step, through the designer's `end` when it is yet to run this pass, else as a command of its own noted for Cancel (`source::set`, `blueprint::note_command`): another switch position, a press elsewhere, the group closed with the keyboard in it (`source::left` in `follow`); a draft that does not read is kept as typed, and the pages ask for it to be put right; the canvas shows what is typed where it reads (`typed_source`, the window's text, or the settings' with the variant edited in its place). **Following** (as the review round left it): the control chosen in the design brings the text's cursor to its first line, that line alone marked, the text scrolled to it (`source::span`, a walk of the JSON text from pointer to bytes; `State::source_lines`); a click in the text chooses the control it is in, and the cursor moved by the keys goes on choosing while it was the text that chose (`control_at`, the deepest of the window's controls, through `Picked::chosen`, as Layers' choice is done); a variant edited maps `/root/…` to `/views/NAME/…` in Binding JSON, and choosing one moves the switch there once. **Keys**: while the source group is the active editor the canvas takes none (`table_view::active_tab` is the source's), Delete and Tab are the text's (`code_editor` keeps the focus: Tab writes a tab); a press on the canvas gives them back. **Checks** (`nui_view::checks`): `Panel::Checks` in the Bottom Dock by U13's table (its `dock`, `name`, `named`, icon `CheckCircle`, `strip_tip`, `keys` (`Keys::NuiChecks`, F6 giving its first row's link the focus), `KEYED` 23, `available_with`, its switch's tip), brought by the designer's `Brings::bottom` (`NUI_BOTTOM`), its window's bottom pane where it floats; the switch's badge counts errors and warnings, in `error` where one is an error, else `warn` (`checks::badge`), its bar's end saying "crier: 0 errors · 1 warning" (`checks::detail`); each row the kind's mark and word, the control (a link: chosen on the canvas, in Layers and in the source), the message cut to its line and whole in its tip, the fix at its right (Bind It, Turn It Off, Add Close Handler, editing the working copy through `main_root` and `end`: one Undo step); what does not read first; "The checks found nothing." with nothing; rows made once for the findings, those in sight laid out. **Only a failure opens it** (U13): more errors than the frame before push `Moonglow::nui_checks_forward`, done at the next frame's start (`shell::nui_forward`): docked, Checks to the front and the Bottom Dock opened where the designer is the active editor; floating, its window's bottom pane; warnings, and fewer errors, open nothing. **The header's Build & Compile** stays off while the checks count errors, its tip "Fix the N errors first: Checks shows them". **The Status Bar** (`nui_view::shown`, the designer's or its source group's in front): "Not built" or "Build failed" (its reason in the tip) in `warn` (`shell::Count::warn`; the kit's `StatusItem::warn`, added), then "3 binds, 3 handlers"; a floating designer says the first in its header (`BUILD_STATE`, the Floating board's place for a floating editor's state: the Status Bar is the main window's docked editor's). Its hints, by `HintKeys` as bound (remapped shows remapped): Click Select, Drag Resize by handle, Esc Cancel resize, and with a control chosen (not the root) Ctrl + D Duplicate, Alt + Up Move up, Delete; in Interact Click Try a control; none while a field is typed in, a popover, dialog or menu is open, on the other pages, in Preview only for the keys, or while the source group is in front; they yield as every editor's. **The canvas's corners** (`preview::stage::corners`): at its top left "Game preview · UI scale 100% · State: Follow pointer" (the window's size and "game resources, local layout preview" in its tip; "Interact · UI scale…" with Interact's words in its tip; "Preview · game skin unavailable…" without the skin), the resources' issues under it or, with View › Resources, where each picture and font came from; at its bottom left what is not drawn here and Interact's last event; at its bottom right the zoom, Fit and 100% (a kit segmented control named "Zoom"); each on a chip of the bar's ground, readable in both themes over the game's black; only the zoom takes the pointer, and only where it stands; the window is fitted to the whole room (no rows over and under it). The View popover gains **Zoom** (its tip names it, as the board's). **Layers** (`panels::rows`): each control's ID after its name in weak words, else the bind its value takes (the board's "Label  fee_text"); a control a check names marked at its row's right (an error's or a warning's mark, its tip the message, a click choosing the control and bringing Checks to the front); the rows made again when the findings change. **The bind chip** (`form::bind_chip`, the board's `.bind-chip`): a bound property's row is its label and the chip (the link icon in `accent`, the bind's name in the code font, cut to its room, named "Bound to NAME"), its `…` beside as before; a click shows the property in **Property Binding** (opened and brought into sight), where its Source changes the bind or Constant takes it off, with its initial value and, moved there from under the row, its **Bind Formatting**: nothing of today's Property Binding lost. **Bindings as the board's table** (`design::bindings_table`): a header row (Name, Initial Value, Watch), a row a bind (its name and its value as JSON in the code font, cut short and whole in its tip), Watch a check that adds or takes off its Value changed handler (one Undo step), a row chosen by a click; the binds the window names without a value ("Add Value"); then Custom window ID (empty: the window's name; one set is edited where it is, set as it is left or its panel goes as every field is; none set, a name typed is given as the field is left, let go if its panel goes first) and the two delivery checks, their help as tips (`window_settings`); then the chosen bind's form (name and Rename, initial value by its kind, When This Value Changes, Used by, Delete); **New Bind**, the plus on its header (on the one bar's own top row under 1400), opens Create Bind's dialog. **The Bindings page against the panel**, by the board (the panel is the table on every page): the page's body is every bind's form with Create Bind, no window settings (the panel's), the panel the table and the settings alone (no chosen form), so each field is drawn once; a row chosen there brings the page's form into sight. A bind renamed with a variant edited reaches the window's own controls and the variant's (U18's F17 holds, its test now choosing the row first); renamed while a field elsewhere is typed in: not tested apart (the press on Rename leaves the field first, as every field's).

**Decided.** (1) The source shows the module's text, not a re-serialized copy: Split source's text (pretty JSON of the working copy) and the JUI Source page's (the module's bytes) were two; the one group shows what the module holds, as the page did, so a text that does not read is still there to put right, and the per-bytes serialization cache is gone. (2) What is typed is set by the designer's frame's end where it is yet to come, else as a command of its own: egui_dock draws the groups in its own order, and two ends in a pass would write twice. (3) Selection following (the brief says Split source did it: it did not) is built both ways, the text's change by the cursor only when the cursor moves, so the two never fight. (4) Floating, the window grows for the source rather than the design shrinking: the design keeps its panes, as U18's first size asks. (5) The Status Bar's counts and state are shown for the source group too (it is the designer's part); its hints are not (the canvas's keys are not its). (6) Esc Cancel resize is shown with the others, as the board shows it, though Esc acts only during a resize. **Plan against board**: (1) the board's Status Bar has a Problems switch between Log and Checks: U20 builds Problems; (2) the board's Checks bar says its count after its tab, ours at the bar's end, where the Bottom Dock's tab bar keeps its tools; (3) the board's Bottom Dock is one row high (92), ours at the height the builder left it; (4) the board draws no form under the Bindings table: the chosen bind's form is there (below the fold at the board's size) so nothing of the page is lost from the panel; (5) the board shows the canvas at 1.4 (its Fit); ours fits a window larger than the canvas down to it and never enlarges a smaller one, as the tip's Fit did (`stage::canvas`, unchanged: the zoom clamped to 1); (6) no board draws a floating NUI designer: its build state in its header follows the Floating board's script. **Renamed**: Advanced (the menu) gone, its items the source group's; "Dynamic · NAME" under a bound property → its chip; Client Delivery and Window Identity (folding sections) → the settings under the table; the Bindings panel's Create Bind → New Bind (the header's plus; the page keeps Create Bind); "Checks passed" and "N errors · M warnings" → the switch's badge and the bar's "crier: 0 errors · 1 warning". **Nothing lost**: every row of `target/u19/inventory.txt` is at its new place and working, docked and floating, at every header width (`header_holds` from 420 to 1600, the floating header's build state among them).

**Review, 2026-11-18.** An independent review of U19 (its notes, breaks and probes in `target/review-u19/`) held the core (the source set when left, the keys the active group's, following both ways, the Checks count, the dock on a new error, "Not built" until a build, the restart record, the floating width given back) and found the faults below; the coordinator ruled on them. Each is fixed, each new or strengthened test seen to fail with its fix taken out (`target/u19/breaks.txt`, "Fix round": X1 to X22). **The coordinator's rulings**: the source is bound to its design (every way it opens goes through `open_nui_source`; it never stands without its design); a floating designer's place is given back; the Bindings table walks the window by its bytes alone; the design follows the source only on a click, or on a caret move while it was the source that chose (nothing or one control); a typed source is set on Save and on closing as a field is; a new Custom window ID typed is set as its panel goes; the board's cursor line and the table's marked row. **Fixed.** (A1) Reopen Closed Tab after the source's × brought it back as a plain tab in the design's group: `Action::OpenTab(Tab::NuiSource)` now goes to `open_nui_source`, which opens the design first where it is not open (`run_now(OpenTab(Nui))`); a record of the source without its design opens the design and the source beside it (`restore_tabs`, the switch kept); a design dragged anywhere and closed takes its source with it (`follow`), split off by Split Editor or out to a window of its own too; `Tab::NuiSource` has `renamable` and `window_size` arms (every `match` on `Tab` gone through: `tree_key`, `retarget`, the plugins' two, `kind`, `fits`, the tab's name for a screen reader, "crier.jui source", and its tip; the strip shows the design's name, the board's); and a source drawn while its design is hidden behind another tab notes the new errors that open Checks (`checks::note_failures` from `source::ui` too) (`the_source_is_bound_to_its_design` [X1, X2, X21], `new_errors_open_checks_with_the_design_hidden` [X3], `the_source_group_comes_back_with_its_switch`, now the design opened first [X22]). (A2) A floating designer's place was not given back (the window held at the screen's left): `nui_widened` keeps the place before and the place given; closed, the window goes back where it was unless the builder moved or sized it meanwhile (then theirs, narrowed by the room it was given), put there again once narrow as a maximized window's way back is (`WindowTrack::aim`), the frame that moves it asked for (`remember_window_sizes`, `follow`) (`a_floating_designer_s_place_comes_back`, three times round and once moved, at 1280 and 1600 [X4, X5]). (A3) The chart's 30 → 19.5 ms was the tip's Bindings panel walking the window twice a frame, dropped by accident and back with a bind chosen: `design::bindings_table` keeps where the window names each bind for its bytes (`design::BindsSeen`, `State::binds_seen`), so no frame walks it, a bind chosen or not (`the_bindings_table_walks_the_window_once_for_its_bytes` [X6]); timed below with and without a bind chosen. (A4) An error fixed and made again opens the dock again: tested (the count test's Redo with the dock closed [X7]). (A5) "A warning opens nothing" now fails on its own assertion, frames counted rather than settled; the request is made once for each new error, as it was (`issues_seen`) [X8]. (A6) The design followed every caret move: now only a click in the text, or a caret move while nothing or one control is chosen and the source chose it (`State::source_chose`); a choice made on the canvas or in Layers is not replaced by reading with the keys, and several chosen are never let go by the caret, by keys or a click (`the_design_and_the_source_follow_each_other`, rewritten [X9, X10]). **Suspected, probed.** Plugins saw nothing with the source in front: `plugin_open` and `tab_selection` map it to its JUI (`with_the_source_in_front_plugins_and_the_outliner_see_its_design` [X17]; the Outliner lists its Layers). Save and closing skipped typed source: `store_typed` sets the source's draft first (`source::store`), onto the bytes it was typed over (`SourceDraft::from`), the field keeping the keyboard; closing the tab or the design sets it onto those bytes or lets it go (`source::left`, `typed_over`); closing the module writes nothing, as a field's (`the_source_s_typing_is_saved_and_never_written_over_other_bytes` [X12, X13]). A second docked designer opened in the first's source group: a designer opens among the designs (`Moonglow::design_group`) (`a_second_docked_designer_opens_among_the_designs` [X14]); no list of tabs (a window's tab list, Reopen's) exists beyond the strip and Reopen's one command, so the source is told apart where a name is said: its screen-reader name "crier.jui source" and its tip. The source's body passed over its whole text each frame: the draft is read again only where the module holds other bytes (a pointer's comparison), its lines counted as it changes, its galley kept for its draft's count of changes and what it was laid out with (not asked of the text while it is not typed in), the default settings' text written once for the run (`source::held_of`, `text_of`; timed below). Checks' fix column: each fix as wide as its words ("Add Close Handler" whole), in a narrow window's Bottom Dock and a floating designer's bottom pane (`checks::fix_width`; `the_checks_fixes_are_whole` [X15]). Custom window ID typed with none set and its panel gone: set as it goes (`fields::put_back_settings` and its recover take a new ID as one set; `the_custom_window_id_is_set_as_it_is_left` [X18]). **Board differences.** The source marks the cursor's line alone, the board's line 73; a control chosen in the design or Layers brings the cursor to its first line [X11]. The Bindings table fills the row of the bind the property chosen in Property Binding takes its value from (the board's `can_send`), and rings the bind chosen in the table, whose form is under it; a row both is filled and ringed [X19]; the chip by the keyboard (focus, Enter) [X20]. Fit is the tip's: a window larger than the canvas is fitted down to it, a smaller one never enlarged (the board's 1.4 is not reached); kept. Kept and listed: the Bottom Dock's other tabs and its height, Checks' count at the bar's end, the log's line in the Status Bar, Problems (U20); `board_nui` now shows Behavior's chip in sight with Property Binding on Enabled above it, the source's cursor line and the table's marked row. **Not probed by the reviewer, probed.** Split Editor on the source and the source out to a window of its own, then the design closed: gone with it (in `the_source_is_bound_to_its_design`); the corners at 100% over a control under them: a click on the zoom chooses nothing, one beside it the control, Clean view keeps them (`the_canvas_s_corners_take_no_click_beside_them` [X16]); the Checks count against the tip's for one window: the same, both from `mg_nui::validate` (read from the code: the count adds what does not read, as the tip's toggle did); the badge in Light and the switches at 1280: `board_nui` Light, `nui-1280`, `nui-narrow` (icons alone under 1400, yielding as every editor's); two floating designers each with a source (`the_source_group_of_a_second_designer_…`); the narrow layout with Checks (`the_checks_fixes_are_whole` at 1000); hints with NUI keys remapped (`the_canvas_hints_…`); the chip by keyboard [X20]; the table with forty binds scrolled to its last, renamed after a property's field was typed in (`a_table_of_many_binds_and_a_rename_while_a_field_is_typed_in`); the Outliner with the source in front (its Layers); an old record with Split source on as the tip wrote it: the tip wrote no Layout (its `view_mode` was the session's), so it opens on the Editor, as U18's records test reads. **An older Moonglow** reading a record with `nui-source:` (read from `open_tabs.rs` at the M3 merge, `89e62b7f`): `parse_tab` gives no tab for a kind it does not know, the tab is passed over with a trace note ("not understood"), no fault; the source's pane, left with no tab, goes (`Laid::of`), the split with it, and the design takes the room; a source in front leaves the pane's front to its first tab. **Changed in code**: `lib.rs` (`open_nui_source`, `design_group`, `tracked_window`, `Action::OpenTab` for a source, `nui_widened` with places and `aim`, `remember_window_sizes` asking for the frame it puts a window again in), `open_tabs.rs` (`restore_tabs`), `tabs.rs` (`renamable`, `window_size`, the source's name and tip), `plugins.rs`, `nui_view.rs` (`follow`, `store_typed`, the state's new fields), `nui_view/source.rs` (`body` rewritten: following, the cursor line, the draft by its bytes, `store`, `left`, `typed_over`, `held_of`), `nui_view/checks.rs` (`fix_width`), `nui_view/design.rs` (`BindsSeen`, the table's marks, the window ID), `nui_view/fields.rs` (a new window ID's put-back and recover), `nui_view/form.rs` (`chip_asked` keyed by designer); `pub` added: `Moonglow::nui_chosen_many`, `Moonglow::nui_binds_walks` (doc-hidden, for the tests). **Pictures** (Dark and Light, `target/ui-mock/impl/m4-u19-fix/`): `board_nui` (the chip in sight, the cursor line, `can_send` marked) and every `nui_panels` shot, looked at against `Nui.png`, `Nui_right.png` and `Nui_fix_hdr4.png`. **Timing** (`target/ui-mock/perf-m4/u19-fix/`: `summary.txt`, `runs.log`, `loads.txt`), after the last code edit: `nui_perf`'s cases and two new, `a_large_window_with_its_source` and `a_chart_with_a_bind_chosen` (the chart with a bind chosen in the table; in the tip's copy the helper choosing it is a no-op: its panel showed every bind's form), release, each test alone, a fresh tip copy (`a4184c2c`, patched alike) and U19 interleaved over three rounds, every run begun at a 1-minute load of 2.68 to 2.91. Medians of the three runs' medians, tip against U19: the large window idle 0.815 against 0.881 ms, after an edit of the window 1.900 against 2.004 (worst 4.82 against 4.75), after an edit elsewhere 0.809 against 0.883; a variant edited 0.969 against 1.044; the window of text 0.594 against 0.660; the source beside the large window 0.841 against 0.930; the chart of a million samples 32.70 against 19.05 ms (U19's third run 57.05, the machine taken meanwhile), with a bind chosen 33.67 against 19.01. The chart's 13 ms less is the tip's Bindings panel walking the window twice a frame (the review's probe: 18.6 ms with the walk skipped in the tip), which U19's table does once for its bytes, a bind chosen or not (the two cases agree): this replaces the Done paragraph's "not measured". **U20. The tileset editor and the Problems panel (2 days).**

- **Builds.** The Tileset board: the five pages as a switch, Save, Make Palette, Check, Render Minimap Pictures, OK and Cancel; the bar over the tile list (Find, Duplicate Tile, Add Tile, Remove Last Tile); the list as a table (#, Model, Corners, Edges); the form at the right, the doors under it; Right Dock **Preview** (open the model in a tab, the diagram and the door sentence) and **Textures**; the Outliner (General, Terrains, Crossers, rules, Tiles, Groups with counts); **Problems**, the global panel, fed first by Check, its switch with an error badge; counts and hints (Click Choose a tile, Ctrl + F Find, Ctrl + S Save the tileset).
- **Ticks.** Every Tileset Editor row and its New bullets; Window at 1280's switches row (Problems).
- **Tests.** tiles.rs's page lookups through the switch; new: Check's findings in Problems with the badge's count, a click going to the tile; the Outliner's counts.
- **Pictures.** `board_tileset`.
- **Timing.** `frame_perf` (the tile table of 408 rows).
- **Hands on.** Problems to U28 (Build Module, Verify).
- **Docs.** 04-areas "Making tilesets". Deferred: keeps 1181, 1195, 1566.

**Done, 2026-11-18.** **Built.** **The header** (`tileset_view::header`, the kit's `EditorHeader` "Tileset header"): the five pages as the kit's segmented control "Page" (General, Terrains and Crossers, Painting Rules, Tiles, Groups, a tip each; into More last, with Save), a line, **Save** (primary, the tileset's file), a line, **Make Palette**, **Check**, **Render Minimap Pictures** (off without a GPU, its tip saying so), **OK** and **Cancel** in the end slot (`side_doc::pressed_ok_cancel`: OK saves and closes, Cancel closes as last saved asking first). The editor's Undo and Redo left it for the Top Bar's (the side editor's path, `side_doc`: the tileset's steps with the pointer over the editor or its docked panels, `note_pointer` in Preview, Textures and the Outliner, or the tile list with the keys, `undo_keys`). **The Tiles page** (`tiles`): the list at the left (the board's 548, the form keeping at least 380; under each other where the editor is narrower than 680, decided by the editor's own room, never by a scroll bar's), **the bar over it** (`tile_bar`: Find, "Model or terrain", taking the room the buttons leave, Ctrl+F with the pointer over the page; Duplicate Tile, Add Tile, and Remove Last Tile the minus, named so; their words go first where the bar is narrow), **the table** (`tile_table`, on `table_view::look` as U17's list: a header row #, Model, Corners, Edges, rows 22 high and only those in sight laid out, the number quiet at its right, model and edges monospace, a hole's words in `warn`, the chosen row filled and ringed while the list has the keys; a click chooses a tile and gives the list `Keys::Tiles`, Up, Down, Page Up, Page Down, Home and End acting only while the tileset is the active editor, `list_has_keys`; F6 stops there, `editor_keys`); **the form** (`tile_form`: "Tile N" and its model, the hole's note, Model, Walkmesh, Minimap picture, Path node as monospace fields filling the row's room, Orientation, the flags in up to four columns, each corner's terrain (at most 196) "height" and its number, each edge's crosser; `form_row` gives each field the room the row leaves) and **the doors under it** (`door_hooks`: the board's table, Type, the doortypes label, X, Y, Z and Orientation with a fraction always, "3.0"; Add Door with its plus, Remove Last Door). The bar's buttons act after the list and the form are drawn (`BarAsked::run`), so that both are drawn from one reading (corrected at the review: not for the typed text, which is set before the press acts whatever the order). The other pages are today's, each scrolled in the editor's room. **Right Dock** (`Brings` of `Tab::Tileset`: Preview over Textures, shares 1008 and 992, one tab bar under 1400, `floats`; `Brings::diagram` so the Preview is the tileset's whatever the palettes): **Preview** (`tileset_view::panels::preview`, its header "Tile 16, tcn01_c02_01" and the open-in-tab icon "Open the Model in a Tab", off with today's Preview button's tip where the game data has not the model): the diagram as the board's `.tp` (dashed frame, the corners' names, terrains and heights, the edges' crossers or a dash, the middle the model's name, "0°, 1 door", the name in `error` and "not in the game data" where it is missing; bands kept whole, the middle smaller in a small panel), the door sentence a line a door ("Door 1: doortypes.2da row 0, at (-0.58, 3.00, 0.20), turned 270°", wrapped; "No doors…"), and the tile's model in 3D under the diagram where 180 points are left (U11's model view, `model_view::panel`; where the model has a tab of its own it says so); **Textures** (`model_textures::panel`, its header "of tcn01_c02_01 (21)" or "(21, 2 missing)"): a row a texture (its icon and name, both in `error` where missing), its picture, file, origin, TXI, uses and materials in its tip, today's menu on a right click, Copy at its right; only the rows in sight; `Keys::Textures` (F6 to the first Copy). **The Outliner** (`outliner::tileset`, `Owner::Tileset`, `Contents::Tileset` whatever is open; the panel over it 394 high, the board's, kept apart: `Settings::parts_panel_height`): its header "Outliner" and "tcn01 City Exterior" (the file's name and the name shown) with Expand All and Collapse All; General, Terrains, Crossers, Primary rules, Secondary rules, Tiles, Groups with their icons and counts (none: quiet, no arrow), Terrains and Crossers open at first; the parts "cobble", "0 Grass beside Water makes Sand", "16 tcn01_c02_01", "3 Bridge (2×1)", named for a screen reader "Terrain 0: cobble", "Tile 16: tcn01_c02_01"; the rows made once for the file's revision and the groups open (`outline_rows`) and laid out in sight alone; a group's arrow a button of its own ("Open Tiles"); a click goes to the page and the row (the tile or group chosen, Find let go of where it hides the tile) and gives the list `Keys::Marks` (Up, Down, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, Right and Left opening and closing, Enter going there, letters by the rows' words, Escape); a floating tileset's window's left pane or its strip (the page keeps the tip's 918: `WINDOW_TILES_AT_FIRST`). **The Status Bar** (`tileset_view::shown`): "408 tiles, 89 groups, 5 terrains, 4 crossers" with the path in its tip; on Tiles Click Choose a tile, and Find's keys as bound while the pointer is over the page (where they go to its field); no Save hint (corrected at the review: Ctrl+S is the module's Save); none while a field is typed in, a popover, dialog or menu is open. **Problems** (`problems.rs`, `Panel::Problems`, the Bottom Dock's global panel by U13's table: tabs Problems, Search Results, Log; switches Log, Problems, the editor's own, Search Results, so Problems stands between Log and Checks as the NUI board draws it; `Keys::Problems`, F6 to its first link): **the model**: `Problems { sets }`, each `Set { source, problems, stale }`; a `Problem` is its severity, where it is in words ("Tile 17, Model", "Group 0, Tile0", "General, Transition"), its message and `go` (a way there: `Go::Tileset { path, place }`, `tileset_view::Place` parsed from the doctor's `at`, a model's own finding at its first tile); a source is `Source::Tileset(path)`; `replace` puts a source's findings in place of its last (errors first), never appended; U28 adds `Source::Build` and `Source::Verify` and their `Go` arms (and Verify's fixes, Q5: no wider now). **What opens the dock**: Check run by hand follows U13's rule for a search, not U19's for a new error (it was asked for): anything found opens the main window's Bottom Dock on Problems (`ask_forward`, `shell::problems_forward` at the frame's start); nothing found opens nothing, the log says "Check: zzc01.set: no problems found" and the panel's heading "No problems found". **A second Check** replaces the first's. **A change** to the file after its Check says its findings are "changed since the check" (`TilesetDoc::checked` against its revision) until Check runs again; **closing** the tileset keeps them (a click opens the file again on the place, its findings its own again, `open_path`), "closed without saving" where its changes were let go (`forget_side`). **The badge** counts every source's errors and warnings (counted as they change), in `error` where one is an error (the board's), Check's own count for one tileset (tested). **Empty**: the kit's empty state, the problems icon, "No problems found", "A tileset's Check lists what it finds here." **A click** on a finding's place goes there: the tileset brought forward (opened again where closed), the page, the row in sight, the field it names given the keyboard the frame after the click (egui lets go of the focus at a click elsewhere as its pass ends). **A floating tileset**: Problems stays the main window's (no bottom pane in its window); its Check opens the main window's dock (tested). **The badges at 1280**: the switches show their icons alone under 1400, by U13's ruling, Problems' badge kept (`nui-1280`). **Redraw**: the panel is drawn before the editor; a change of its findings in the same pass asks for one more frame (`Problems::drawn`, `follow_bottom`). **Today's place for Check's findings** (the lines under the row) is gone: Problems is where they are.

**Decided.** (1) Problems keeps a changed tileset's findings, marked, rather than forgetting them at the first change (today's rule): a click on the next finding after putting one right still goes somewhere, and the mark says what it is worth; listed, not counted (the coordinator's ruling at the review). (2) Check by hand opens the dock as a search does. (3) Problems' tab before Search Results (GalleryWide), Search Results before the Log (Script). (4) The empty state has no Verify Module button: Verify feeds Problems from U28. (5) No Save hint (the review's ruling). (6) The model in 3D under the diagram where there is room (the brief's U11 Preview; the board has the diagram alone at its size, where ours has no room for it either). **Plan against board**: (1) the board's Top Bar says "Save tcn01.set (Ctrl+S)" and its Status Bar "tcn01.set (modified)": plan against board, the owner's ruling 2026-11-18: Save stays the module's (Ctrl+S saves the module and the tileset with it; the Status Bar names the module); (2) the board's Problems switch tip says "Verify Module's findings, and the tileset's Check": ours "what the tileset's Check found" until U28; (3) at the board's size Render Minimap Pictures shows its icon alone: our editor is 1003 wide against the board's 1017 (the docks' widths are earlier tasks'); (4) the board's # column, 36, kept (corrected at the review: its padding narrower, so three digits are whole); Copy on the chosen Textures row alone, as the board (corrected at the review); (5) the board's Outliner rows of rules and tiles are closed; ours too, Terrains and Crossers open, as drawn; (6) `Tileset_fix_hdr3.png` is the last header crop (its file is the newest, 19:57:46, after `_hdr2` 19:57:41 and `_header` 19:57:39, and `src/Tileset.html` draws its OK and Cancel after a spacer, as it does). **Nothing lost**: every row of `target/u20/inventory.txt` is at its new place, docked and floating, at every header width (`header_holds` from 420 to 1600); the read-only tilesets (the game's, a hak's) are the resource view's text, as today (`tileset-read-only`). **Not built**: nothing re-reads a tileset from disk when the file changes outside (today neither): the typed text test covers the edits made here.

**Review, 2026-11-18.** An independent review of U20 (its notes and probes in `target/review-u20/`) held the editor's core and found the faults below; the coordinator ruled on them. Each is fixed, each new or strengthened test seen to fail with its fix taken out (`target/u20/breaks.txt`, "Fix round": F1 to F19). **The rulings**: a tile's 3D view starts paused; stale findings stay listed and marked but the badge and its error color count current findings only; Save and Ctrl+S stay the module's (the owner's ruling 2026-11-18: plan against board, the board's Top Bar "Save tcn01.set" and Status Bar "tcn01.set (modified)"). **Fixed.** (1) The Preview's 3D view never rested: the game's programs that read the clock (`worldtimerTimeOfDay`, `sceneCurrentFrame`) ask a frame each clock step while the view plays, a tile with nothing moving too (the Done paragraph's "a tile with nothing moving asks for none" was wrong; the rest test had never drawn the view: no GPU, no room at 900 high). A tile's view starts paused (`model_view::Shown::paused`, U11's form Preview unchanged), its own Play animating it, the choice kept as long as the view is (not saved); `the_tile_s_3d_view_rests_until_played` (GPU, 1600 by 1500: paused rests with the view drawn in the last frames, Play keeps asking, Pause rests) [F1]. (2) Staleness went by revision, so Check, an edit and Undo said "changed" for the text checked, and closing without saving said "closed" for a file on disk that was what was checked. Now by fingerprint: `Set::checked` is `problems::fingerprint` of the text Check read; `tileset_view::follow_problems` compares the open text (its hash made once a revision), `closed` the file on disk as the tileset closes, `open_path` the file as it opens again (`check_s_findings…` Undo and Redo, `a_click_in_problems…` reopened, closed without saving the edit, checked with an edit then closed, reopened on the old file) [F2, F3]; every open tileset is followed at each frame's start (`tileset_view::follow_all`), its tab drawn or not: found making the stale picture, a tileset changed behind another tab had stayed counted (`a_tileset_changed_behind_another_tab_is_said_stale`) [F19]. (3) The badge and its color count current sets alone (`Problems::counts`); a stale set's heading says "Changed since the check: not counted" [F4]. (4) A finding whose file is gone marks its set "File not found" (`Stale::Missing`, from `open_path`), not only a log line; a heading's right click offers **Remove from Problems**, and Delete on the focused heading does it (no menu of the toolset opens by a key; the heading is a focusable row); closing the module keeps a tileset's sets (`a_gone_source_is_said_and_a_set_is_removed`) [F5, F6, F7]. (5) A hole's headers said "Preview, Tile 1, " and "Textures, of ": now "Tile 1" alone and no detail (`a_hole_s_headers_say_no_model`) [F8]. (6) A finding of the whole file with no place had an empty link: it is named by the file ("zzt01.set"), a link of words, reached by F6 (`a_finding_of_the_whole_file_names_the_file`) [F9]. (8) `Problems`' sets and revision are private, changed only through `replace`, `set_stale` and `remove`; each set's errors counted as it is set, not each frame. (9) The doors table keeps "Orientation (°)" whole (its column at least its heading and the board's padding, the others narrowed alike where the form is narrower than the board's columns, "Type" heading its number and the row's label together so that it too is whole at 1280); the tile table's # is the board's 36, its number padded 2 and 6 so that three digits are whole; the diagram's model name is one line, cut with … and whole in the diagram's tip. (10) Textures' Copy on the chosen row alone, as the board; a click chooses a row, F6 the first [F13]. (12) Words: "Changed since the check", "Closed without saving", "File not found"; "2 errors" without "· 0 warnings" and the reverse (`problems::counted`); Remove Last Tile's tip "Take the last tile away"; the Problems switch's tip "Show what the checks found, or close it", its strip tip "Problems: what the checks found" (true when U28 feeds it). (13) No Save hint: the 2DA's and the talk table's hints have none for Ctrl+S, which is the module's Save; with no module open Ctrl+S saves nothing, as beside a 2DA opened by Tools › 2DA File… (`Id::Save` needs a module) (`the_tileset_hints_are_as_bound`, which now asserts every absence: away from the page no Find, other pages no Click or Find, typing none, no Save anywhere, and Find's own field taking the keyboard) [F12]. **Kept, said** (11): the Bottom Dock's tabs keep their order (the editor's own, Problems, Search Results, Log), not the switches' (Log, Problems, the editor's own, Search Results): Script.png draws the tabs Compiler, Bookmarks, Search Results, Log and U13's `shell::dock_tests` pins it. **Tests** (7): G4: `typed_text_is_set_before_a_one_frame_click_removes_its_tile` sends the press and its release in one frame with the field shown holding the keyboard; it passes with the bar's action moved before the form too (F11, said): the order is not what sets the text, and that claim is dropped from the code, the Done paragraph and the agdb note (the bar acts after the form so that the list and the form read one revision); the test guards the text being set (F11c). **U21. The hak editor (2 days).**

- **Builds.** The Hak board: Add Files…, Add Folder…, Remove, Extract…, Extract All…, Find, Compile Models, Save, Save As…, More (Update from Folder), OK and Cancel (the kit's header replaces `Tools::fitted`); the notice strip; columns Name, Type, Size, Source with a sort arrow; Right Dock **Preview** (Play or Stop, the model's facts) and **Details** (File, Description, Built from with Update from Folder, Contents); the Outliner by type; hints, "2706 resources, 183.8 MB", "3 selected".
- **Ticks.** Every Hak Editor row and its New bullets.
- **Tests.** hak_closing.rs's `click_in_tab`; icon_tips.rs's names; the 640 and 480 test becomes `header_holds`.
- **Pictures.** `board_hak`. **Timing.** `frame_perf` (a game hak's 2,706 rows sorted by type). **Docs.** 03-modules (the hak editor). Deferred: keeps 426, 2069.

**Done, 2026-11-18.** **Built.** **The header** (`hak_view::header`, the kit's `EditorHeader` "Hak header", `HAK_CONTROLS`): Add Files… and Add Folder… as icons (`Item::icon`, named so, a tip each), a line, **Remove (N)** (named "Remove", its count its shown words), **Extract…**, **Extract All…**, a line, **Find** (196 wide with its clear button, "name or .type", its field's id the hak's, Ctrl+F with the pointer over the editor; primary), then at the right **Compile Models**, a line, **Save** (off for a game hak or unchanged) and **Save As…** (both primary), **More** (Update from Folder, Rename… of the one selected, Edit Table of a 2DA selected: always in More) and **OK** and **Cancel** in the end slot after a line (`side_doc::pressed_ok_cancel`, the typed Description set first). Their words yield to their icons, then go into More, Find, Save and Save As… last; `Tools::of`, `fitted`, `fitted_after`, `word_look` and `word_widget` and `side_doc::ok_cancel` lost their last caller and are gone (the setting stays for U23). Undo and Redo left the editor for the Top Bar's (the side editor's path; Details and the Outliner `note_pointer` and set `undo_keys` while they hold the keys). **The notice strip** (`notice`, the board's 26 high on `bar`, its warning icon and words in `warn`, named by its words): the game hak's sentence, and the resources past 2 GiB (the "Not Drawn" warning, kept here). **The table** (`table`, on `table_view::look`): heads Name, Type, Size, Source (a click sorts, again the other way, the accent arrow; Size the largest first at its first click; named "Type, sorted up"), rows 22 high with only those in sight laid out: the type's icon and the name monospace, the type's words (`kind_words`: "Model", "Texture"…), the size at the right, the file added from cut at its start ("…/test-output/screens-hak/mg_chair.mdl", whole in the row's tip); those selected filled, the one clicked last ringed while the table has the keys. Click, Ctrl+click and Shift+click select (`widgets::select_in_list`, the selection by resource through a sort, Find, an add and a remove; the clicked row kept in sight across a sort or Find); a double click, Enter or the menu's View shows it in the Preview (the Right Dock unfolded on it where docked); the right-click menu (View, Edit Table, Rename…, Extract…, Remove: Not Drawn on the board, kept); Up, Down, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End while the hak is the active editor and nothing modal or a popover is in front (`Keys::Hak`, `table_has_keys`; F6 stops there, `editor_keys`). Its rows, its `Facts` (count, size, past 2 GiB, the types) are made once for each change of the hak: **`Hak::changes`**, new in mg-module, moves at every change, undo, redo and save taken, so an edit by any path is seen (`HakDoc::walks` counts every whole walk; the tip cloned the rows and summed the sizes and the 2 GiB list at every frame). **Right Dock** (`Brings` of `Tab::Hak`: Preview over Details, shares 1278 and 722, the board's 300 of 831 for Details, one tab bar under 1400, `floats`, `diagram` so the Preview is the hak's whatever the palettes): **Preview** (`hak_view::preview`; its header the resource's name with **Open the Model in a Tab**, on for a model the game reads from the hak as saved, and **Close the Preview**): the resource chosen, `preview_key` (the anchor of the selection where it is selected: the one clicked or Ctrl+clicked last, a Shift run's start, the board's first of three; else the first selected by name, as after a Ctrl+click lets go of the anchor), made once for (resource, changes): a picture fitted with "512 by 256 pixels"; a sound with **Play**/**Stop** (it stops when another is chosen, `follow_all`; it looks again every 300 ms while it plays); a table as the resource browser's; a model in 3D (U11's `model_view::panel`, **paused at first**, the U20 ruling) over its **facts** (`ModelFacts`, read once: Type compiled or text, Size, Nodes, Faces, Vertices, Textures, Animations, Supermodel) and where it is drawn from; the rest as text or fields. Only the shown model's view of a hak is kept (arrowed through, each was), a closed hak's go. **Details** (`hak_view::details`): File (cut at its start by folders, "…/data/hk/id_resources.hak", whole in its tip), Contents ("2706 resources, 183.8 MB"), Built from (the folder, or "(not built from a folder)") and **Update from Folder** under it (off with its tip), **Description** (62 high, its id the hak's, `Keys::HakDetails` and F6 give it the keyboard) and the note "For people: the game doesn't show it." **The Outliner** (`outliner::hak`, `Owner::Hak`, `Contents::Hak` whatever is open, the Left Dock holding it alone with no module; the panel over it the board's 412, kept apart: `Settings::types_panel_height`): its header "Outliner" and the hak's file, a row a type with its icon, ".mdl" and its count, the most first; a click finds the type (Find ".mdl", the board's), again shows all, and gives the list `Keys::Marks` (Up, Down, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, Enter finding, letters by extension, Escape); rows in sight alone; a floating hak's window's left pane or its strip. **The Status Bar** (`hak_view::shown`): "2706 resources, 183.8 MB" (the path in its tip) and "3 selected" where any are; with the pointer over the editor Click Select, Ctrl + Click Add to selection (Cmd on macOS), Shift + Click Select range, Double Click View, Right Click More; none while a field is typed in or a popover, dialog or menu is open; no Save hint (the owner's ruling of 2026-11-18). **Typed text**: the Description is set as its field is left, on Save and Save As…, on OK, on the module's Save, before the closing question, and when its field is drawn no more (another hak in front, the dock folded: `follow_all` at each frame's start); while typed it counts as unsaved and as the Undo step "Description" (the Top Bar's Undo was off after a Save, the hak's steps cleared, and its click only set the text). **Rename…** asks for the keyboard once (it asked at every frame, so Enter never ended it, at the tip too).

**Decided.** (1) The Outliner's click **filters** (Find ".mdl"), as the board draws Find holding ".mdl" with that row chosen. (2) The Preview follows the selection (its anchor where selected, else the first by name), not a double click alone; Close puts it away until another is chosen. (3) Compile Models' results and Update from Folder's report stay the log's, as today: Problems is U28's. (4) A model's facts are listed under its 3D view (the board's placeholder draws them alone). (5) **Plan against board**: (a) the plan's "Add Files…, Add Folder…" words: the board (`Hak.png`, `Hak-h.png`, `src/Hak.html`) draws their icons; (b) the plan's "More (Update from Folder)": the board's More holds Update from Folder, Rename… and Edit Table; (c) the board's Status Bar names the module ("chess"); ours its own; Save stays the module's (the owner's ruling); (d) `Hak_fix_hdr3.png` is the last of the header crops (19:57:46, after `_hdr2` 19:57:41 and `_header` 19:57:39: OK and Cancel after More and a line), and `src/Hak.html` (11 Nov 02:51) and `Hak.png` postdate all three and govern the left end; (e) the board's ".mdl 93" beside 2706 resources: ours counts the added `mg_chair.mdl` too. (6) `show_dock_panel(Preview)` no longer asks for the palettes where the active editor's Preview is its own (`Brings::diagram`): a tileset's too. (7) `Sort::Size` alone now sorts the smallest first (`descending` turns it), the old "By size" being Size's first click. (8) `model_view::a_tab_may_show` lost its hak clause: a hak's tab draws no model now. **Nothing lost**: every row of `target/u21/inventory.txt` is at its new place, docked and floating, at every header width (`header_holds` from 420 to 1600). **Records**: the tip wrote no preview pane or width for a hak (its inline preview kept none); its open-tabs record (`chosen`), its "hak" window size and a dock layout naming a panel it never had read without fault (tested).

**Review, 2026-11-18.** An independent review of U21 (its notes in `target/review-u21/`) found the faults below; the coordinator ruled on them. Each is fixed, each new or strengthened test seen to fail with its fix taken out (`target/u21/breaks.txt`, "Fix round": F1 to F13, `breaks_fix.py`). **Fixed.** (1) **A game hak's Save had no guard in a test**: `the_notice_says_a_hak_is_the_game_s` passed with `&& !in_game` dropped (the hak was clean, Save off anyway); it now changes the game's hak first, then asserts Save off and Save As… on [F1]. (2) **The past-2 GiB notice was untested**: `the_notice_says_what_starts_past_2_gib` adds a sparse file of 2.2 GB and one after it, the strip saying how many would start past 2 GiB, gone with Undo [F2]. (3) **The Outliner's click threw away what Find held** (the coordinator's ruling): a type chosen keeps Find's text (`HakDoc::find_before`, `type_find`), its second click (or another type's, then its own) puts it back; typed over meanwhile, Find is the builder's own and nothing is put back (`follow_all` lets go of both); the type's row marked exactly while Find holds it (`a_type_chosen_keeps_what_find_held`, typed text first) [F3, F3b].
